versions.changelog:
all-round-travel-planner v1.0.0

- Initial release of an all-purpose travel planner skill.
- Creates complete travel itineraries covering dining, accommodation, attractions, and transportation.
- Supports both domestic and international destinations.
- Collects and organizes essential information like departure, destination, trip duration, group type, budget, preferences, and special needs.
- Automatically recommends and compares transport options (flight, high-speed rail, self-drive, coach), and provides real-time flight fare checks when needed.
- Outputs structured, actionable plans with budgeting, route suggestions, daily schedules, food and hotel guides, tips, and backup options.
- Supports flexible output formats, including Markdown, HTML, tables, documents, and presentations.
